recipes.name: No-Bake Pumpkin Mousse Pie
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vanilla bean paste or King Arthur Pure Vanilla Plus
half an 8-ounce package (114g) cream cheese, at room temperature
1 1/2 teaspoons King Arthur Pumpkin Pie Spice*
3/4 teaspoon vanilla bean paste or King Arthur Pure Vanilla Plus
sentences: Press the crumbs into the bottom and up the sides of a 9" pie pan that’s at least 1 1/4" tall.

To make the filling: In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment or working in a large bowl with an electric hand mixer, beat the cream and vanilla until the mixture starts to look foamy, about 20 seconds.

Sift the confectioners’ sugar into the cream and continue beating on medium-high until the cream becomes thick and voluminous and forms medium peaks, about 45 to 90 more seconds (be careful not to overwhip).
Cover the pie with plastic wrap or your favorite reusable wrap, pressing directly onto the surface, and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or up to 24 hours.

To make the topping: In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment or working in a large bowl with an electric hand mixer, make sweetened whipped cream following the directions in step 3.
Storage information: Store leftover pumpkin mousse pie, covered, in the refrigerator for 3 days.

recipes.name: Mini Apple Cider Cakes
recipes.yield: one 9" x 13" sheet cake; or about 10 mini layer cakes
ingredients: 1/3 cup (113g) boiled cider or 1/3 cup (93g) apple juice concentrate, thawed
3 cups (360g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
2 1/2 teaspoons King Arthur Apple Pie Spice
2 1/2 cups (283g) apples, peeled and finely chopped
1 teaspoon Instant Clearjel, optional; it helps the frosting hold its shape
1 cup (227g) heavy cream or whipping cream
1 teaspoon King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
2 drops lemon oil or 1 teaspoon lemon zest, optional
sentences: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Grease, flour, and line with parchment a half sheet pan or 9" x 13" pan.
Bake until the cake springs back when pressed lightly in the middle, about 30 to 40 minutes (the 9" x 13" pan will take the longer amount of time; the half sheet pan, the shorter).
Remove from the oven, and cool in the pan for 1 hour.
If cutting the large cake into circles for mini layer cakes, place it in the freezer for 2 to 3 hours before cutting.
Whisk in 1/4 of the whipped cream and stir until completely combined.
For mini layer cakes, use a 2 3/4" biscuit cutter to cut 20 circles out of the cake baked in the half sheet pan.

recipes.name: Fresh Fruit Cobbler
ingredients: 1 cup (120g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
1/2 cup (113g) dry sherry, brandy, or bourbon, or the fruit juice of your choice
about 4 cups (454g) fresh fruit, diced or sliced; or berries*
sentences: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Lightly grease a 9” square pan or 2 1/2-quart casserole dish.
To make the filling: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, simmer together the liquor or juice and sugar for 3 to 4 minutes.
Bake the cobbler for 30 minutes, until it's bubbling and the cake topping is a light golden brown.

recipes.name: Quick and Easy Icing
ingredients: 2 cups (227g) confectioners' sugar, sifted if lumpy
1 teaspoon King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
3 to 4 tablespoons (43g to 57g) milk, evaporated milk, or heavy cream, plus more as needed
sentences: In a medium bowl, whisk all the ingredients together, starting with 3 tablespoons (43g) milk or evaporated milk or 4 tablespoons (57g) cream. (Cream will make a richer icing.)
If using milk or evaporated milk, add more of the liquid 1/2 teaspoon at a time, stirring between additions.
If using cream, add water in 1/2-teaspoon increments. (For soft, thick icing that’s suitable for spreading on top of cinnamon rolls, you may not need additional liquid.)
It will become somewhat firm and set after about 10 to 20 minutes, depending on the consistency.
Storage information: Transfer any leftover icing to an airtight container, press a piece of plastic wrap against the surface, cover, and refrigerate for up to 3 days.

recipes.name: Jalebi
ingredients: 1 cup (120g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
2 tablespoons (11g) chickpea flour, or besan flour/gram flour
sentences: Cover the bowl and allow the batter to ferment (rest) at room temperature for at least 12 hours.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer until the syrup registers between 223°F and 235°F on a digital or candy thermometer.
Turn off the heat and allow the syrup to cool to between 150°F and 160°F.
To fry the jalebi: Pour the vegetable oil into a Dutch oven or deep-sided skillet; it should be at least 1” deep.
Heat the oil to 330°F.
Pour the batter into a piping bag fitted with a small round tip (1/4” or smaller), or a squeeze bottle.
Pipe or squeeze batter into the hot oil in swirl shapes about 3” wide.
Press down gently, letting the jalebi soak for up to 30 seconds.

recipes.name: Choco-Mallow
ingredients: 2 2/3 cups (454g) chopped dark chocolate or chocolate chips
1/2 cup (113g) heavy cream or whipping cream
1 teaspoon King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
13 marshmallows, (85g) halved around the circumference, or 1 cup (85g) mini marshmallows
1/2 cup (57g) chopped walnuts, toasted if desired
sentences: Line an 8" x 8" square or 9" round pan with parchment, and grease the parchment.
Spread about 3/4 cup of the melted chocolate in the bottom of the pan.

recipes.name: Small-Batch Cinnamon Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup (120g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
2 tablespoons (28g) unsalted butter, at room temperature
1/2 teaspoon King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
3 tablespoons (40g) light brown sugar or dark brown sugar, packed
2 teaspoons King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
1/2 cup (57g) confectioners' sugar, sifted if lumpy
sentences: Shape the dough into a ball, place it in a bowl, cover, and let it rise until puffy but not necessarily doubled in bulk, 45 to 60 minutes (depending on the warmth of your kitchen).
Prepare the pan of your choice: Line a quarter- or half-sheet pan with parchment, or lightly grease a loaf pan, 8" or 9" square pan, or round pan.
To assemble the small-batch cinnamon rolls: Transfer the dough to a lightly floured work surface and press it into a 4" x 10" rectangle.
Brush the surface of the dough generously with milk and then sprinkle the filling on top, covering all but a 1/2" strip along one short side.
You will now have two rectangles, approximately 2" x 10".
Cover the pan and let the rolls rise for 45 to 60 minutes.
While the small-batch cinnamon rolls are rising, preheat the oven to 375°F.
Bake the rolls for 15 to 18 minutes, until a digital thermometer inserted into the center of one roll reads 190°F.

recipes.name: Chewy Italian Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (180g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
1/4 cup (28g) King Arthur Golden Wheat Flour
2 1/2 cups (300g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
sentences: Cover the bowl, and let rest at room temperature for 12 to 20 hours, until the mixture is very bubbly.
To make the dough: Mix the preferment with the remaining ingredients for 2 to 4 minutes, using an electric mixer set on slow speed.
Increase the mixer speed to medium, and mix for about 4 minutes; the dough will be soft and slightly sticky.
Let the dough rise in a greased bowl, covered, for 1 to 2 hours, until very puffy.
Turn the dough out onto a well-floured surface, and shape it into a 6" x 12" rectangle.
Using a bench knife or pizza wheel, cut out eight 3" square rolls.
Let them rise for about 45 minutes, lightly covered, until they're puffy.
Place a baking stone in the top third of your oven, and preheat the oven to 450°F.
Bake the rolls for 13 to 15 minutes, until they're golden brown.

recipes.name: Maple-Glazed Bacon Doughnuts
ingredients: 1/3 cup (71g) light brown sugar or dark brown sugar, packed
1 teaspoon King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract or 1/2 teaspoon natural maple flavor, or to taste
2 2/3 cup (320g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
6 slices bacon, cooked, cooled, and snipped into squares
about 1/4 cup maple syrup, enough to make a spreadable frosting
sentences: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Drizzle the maple syrup over the bacon, using about 3/4 to 1 teaspoon per doughnut.
Bake the doughnuts for 15 minutes, or until they're raised and firm, and a toothpick inserted into the middle of one comes out clean.
Wrap any leftovers loosely in plastic, and store for 1 day at room temperature; refrigerate or freeze for longer storage.

recipes.name: Chocolate Truffle Torte
yield: one 13" x 4" rectangle, 8" square or 9" round torte
ingredients: 1 scant cup (142g) semisweet chocolate (chips, chunks, wafers, or chopped), we like [product-link]Valrhona Dark Chocolate[/product-link]
1/2 cup (43g) unsweetened cocoa, we like our Triple Cocoa Blend
1 3/4 cups (283g) semisweet chocolate (chips, chunks, wafers, or chopped); we like Valrhona Dark Chocolate
sentences: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Lightly grease a 13 ¾" x 4 ½" rectangular tart pan; or an 8" square pan, or 9" round pan.
If you're using an 8" square or 9" round pan, it's best to line the pan with parchment and grease the parchment, to facilitate turning the cake out of the pan without crumbling.
Bake the torte for 22 to 25 minutes.
Remove it from the oven, and cool it in the pan for 5 minutes.
Scoop out teaspoon-sized bits with the remaining ganache, place on parchment or waxed paper, and chill for 1 hour.
